--------------
-- factOrders
-------------
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON t.schema_id = s.schema_id
WHERE t.name = 'factOrders' and s.name = 'gold')
    CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE gold.factOrders
    WITH(
        LOCATION = 'factOrders',
        DATA_SOURCE = gold_layer,
        FILE_FORMAT = parquetFormat
    )
    AS
    (SELECT
        C. DimCustomerKey,
        P.DimProductKey,
        R.DimRegionKey,
        O.DimOrderKey,
        Quantity,
        UnitPrice,
        TotalAmount
    FROM silver.silverTable F
    LEFT JOIN gold.dimCustomer C ON F.CustomerID = C.CustomerID
    LEFT JOIN gold.dimProduct P ON F.ProductID = P.ProductID
    LEFT JOIN gold.dimRegion R ON F.RegionID = R.RegionID and F.Country = R.Country
    LEFT JOIN gold.dimOrder O ON F.OrderID = O.OrderID
    )
